nodes.speaker: Nikias
nodes.text: Welcome to Piraeus, captain. The merchant house of Kephalos has need of your services.

nodes.speaker: Nikias
nodes.text: We need Tyrian purple from Sidon. The festival of Athena approaches and the priests require new vestments.

effects.title: Commission from Nikias
effects.text: The merchant Nikias of Athens has tasked me with procuring Tyrian purple from the Phoenician city of Sidon.

nodes.speaker: Nikias
nodes.text: Excellent. May Poseidon grant you fair winds. You will find the Phoenician dye merchants near the harbor temple.

nodes.speaker: Nikias
nodes.text: A cautious captain lives longer, I suppose. Return if you change your mind.

nodes.speaker: Nikias
nodes.text: The Phoenicians of Sidon produce the finest purple dye in all the Mediterranean -- extracted from the murex snail. It is worth more than silver by weight.

choices.text: Tell me more about Tyrian purple.

nodes.speaker: Nikias
nodes.text: Each murex yields but a single drop. It takes ten thousand shells to dye one garment. The Phoenicians have guarded this secret for centuries. Pliny himself wrote of its magnificence.

choices.text: Fascinating. I will seek it out.
